request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: single-correct (exactly one option is right)

Two blocks of masses 10 kg and 4 kg are connected by a spring of negligible mass and placed on a frictionless horizontal surface. An impulse gives a velocity of 14 m / s to the heavier block in the direction of the lighter block. The velocity of the centre of mass is
(A) 30 m / s
(B) 20 m / s
(C) 10 m / s

result.working:
Right after the impulse, only the 10 kg block is moving, at 14 m/s. The 4 kg block is still at rest.
Total momentum = 10 × 14 + 4 × 0 = 140 kg·m/s.
v_cm = 140 / (10 + 4) = 10 m/s.
The surface is frictionless and the spring force is internal, so v_cm stays 10 m/s afterwards.
result.note: Only three options (A to C) are given; a fourth option may be missing. This does not change the answer.
